features.job: Upload, preview, replace, or remove one account asset for one caller-owned field.
features.value: One exact JSON value is projected before hydration and emitted after upload or remove.
features.copy: The caller supplies every visible and accessible word; Dieter owns no product copy.
features.loading: Stored-asset resolution renders only the systemic Spinner, exposes the caller-owned accessible status label, and clears busy truth on result or error.
features.policy: The account-assets route remains the upload and account-policy authority.
